weapon.d: Effective against flying foes. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+5 during combat, and also, if unit initiates combat and unit's Spd ≥ foe's Spd+10, unit attacks twice.
Effective against flying foes. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+5 during combat, and also, if unit initiates combat and unit's Spd ≥ foe's Spd+10, unit attacks twice.

assist.d: Unit moves 1 space away from target ally. Ally moves to unit's previous space.

a.d: If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+3 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+5 during combat.

b.d: If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, grants Atk/Spd+2 to unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally for 1 turn.
If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, grants Atk/Spd+4 to unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally for 1 turn.
If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally for 1 turn.
